entry.title: A Simple Referral Request Email That Works – My Job Hunting Trick
entry.summary:
When you’re applying for a job, an internal referral can greatly increase your chances of getting noticed.
This is one of the strategies I’m currently using in my own job hunt, and I’m sharing it so we can all grow together. Below is a simple, professional referral request email template that you can customize and send to someone in your network. Subject: Referral Inquiry - [Job Title] at [Company Name] Hi [Name], Hope this email finds you well! I'm reaching out because I'm very interested in the [Job Title] position currently open at [Company Name]. My experience in [mention relevant skills/experience] aligns well with the requirements listed, and I'm confident I could make a valuable contribution to the team. Given your experience at [Company Name], I was wondering if you'd be open to providing an internal referral. Your recommendation would be incredibly valuable in helping my application stand out. Of course, I completely understand if this isn't something you're comfortable with. Regardless, any insights you could share about the role or the team culture at [Company Name] would be greatly appreciated. I've attached my resume for your reference. Thanks for your time and consideration! Best regards,
[Your Name] Polite & Professional – respectful of the recipient’s time.
Clear Purpose – explains why you’re reaching out and how you fit the role.
Flexible Outcome – leaves room for advice, even if a referral isn’t possible.
💡 This is part of the trick I’m using in job hunting. Let’s grow together, folks! 🚀
